title: Packaging Technician — Career Roadmap
summary: A Packaging Technician supports the development, production, testing and quality control of packaging materials such as cartons, labels, corrugated boxes, flexible films and protective packaging. The role combines material knowledge, machine operation, quality checks and production safety.

blocks.label: Recommended route
blocks.text: Class 10 followed by a relevant diploma; Class 12 entry may be available at some institutions.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Computer Applications and basic design.

blocks.label: Entrance exams
blocks.text: State polytechnic entrance tests or institution-specific admission; verify current notifications.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Packaging materials, printing, folding cartons, labels, product protection and recycling.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Measurement, attention to detail, mechanical aptitude, documentation and workplace safety.

items.text: Diploma in Printing & Packaging Technology → Packaging production, printing, converting and quality control.
Diploma in Packaging Technology → Packaging materials, testing, design fundamentals and production processes.
Diploma in Printing Technology → Printed cartons, labels, flexible packaging and prepress support.
Diploma in Mechanical Engineering → Packaging machinery operation and maintenance.
Diploma in Chemical / Polymer Technology → Packaging films, coatings, material properties and testing, where relevant.

blocks.text: For a direct Packaging Technician pathway, prioritise programmes with practical labs, materials testing and industry exposure.
